tex_content.html:
Proposition
Source: topping:page-0092 1. ch8:2.1\group perelman-w-entropy If $\mathcal M$ is closed and \[ \frac{\partial g}{\partial t}=-2\Ric ,\qquad \frac{d\tau }{dt}=-1,\qquad \frac{\partial f}{\partial t}=-\Delta f+|\nabla f|^2-R+\frac{n}{2\tau }, \] then \[ \frac{d}{dt}\mathcal W(g,f,\tau ) =2\tau \int \left|\Ric +\Hess (f)-\frac{g}{2\tau }\right|^2dV\geq 0. \]
